rootCauseProof.expectedBehavior: When an event drops off the live feed after match duration (> 3.5 hours) with confirmed snapshot database records, or when completed micro-markets have conclusive snapshot records, settlement confidence should allow finalization.
rootCauseProof.actualBehavior: isFinalMatch evaluated false because rawStatus was unset and chase balls were 113/120. Because isFinalMatch was false, ageSeconds > 300s triggered STALE_DATA: In-play match data age exceeds max allowed, blocking authorizeSettlement from proceeding to execute betSettlementEngine.settleSingleBet.
rootCauseProof.evidence: Dry run execution on backend container logged: decision: 'BLOCKED', confidence: 'STALE', reasons: ['STALE_DATA: In-play match data age (7165s) exceeds max allowed (300s)']. PostgreSQL match_over_snapshots and match_dismissal_snapshots already contain all verified scores.
rootCauseProof.whyTheBetRemainedOpen: The settlement worker continuously skipped the bets because the confidence engine blocked authorization due to stale in-play data status, preventing the terminal database status update from ever being written to the bets table.
